items.q: And we had another guy, now, that's playing in the Radio City Music Hall pit, named Winston Collimore.

ctx.x: Huh? He's still around now. He's a contractor now. Sure, I run into him every now and then. He's a contractor. We reminisce about that. And we had another guy, now, that's playing in the Radio City Music Hall pit, named Winston Collimore. Those two I didn't know before. I knew Buster but I didn't know these two.
